methodologyNotes: Covers battery-powered ride-on cars, trucks, and tractors for children sold at a published US MSRP (typical retail in USD if no MSRP is listed). Includes single- and multi-seat electric ride-ons; excludes pedal cars, push cars, powered ride-on scooters/ATVs without a car body, and gas-powered vehicles. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD. batteryVoltage is the system voltage in volts (V), typically 6, 12, or 24. batteryCapacityAh is battery capacity in amp-hours (Ah); null if not disclosed. motorCount is the number of drive motors (integer). topSpeedMph is the manufacturer's maximum forward speed in miles per hour. speedSettings is the count of selectable forward speed modes (integer). maxRiderWeightLbs is the rated weight capacity in pounds. seatCapacity is the number of rider seats (integer). recommendedAgeYears is the manufacturer's recommended age range in years, as a string (e.g. "3-6"). runtimePerChargeMin is typical continuous runtime per full charge in minutes; null if not disclosed. parentalRemote is a boolean: true if a parental remote control (typically 2.4GHz) is included. licensedBrand is the real automotive/equipment brand the body is officially licensed from (e.g. "Mercedes-Benz"), or "unlicensed" if the design is generic. productWeightLbs is the assembled product weight in pounds; null if not disclosed.
